description: Turn seller-supplied floor-plan facts and an already-written walk-in script into one talking clip per still. This rental walk-in studio turns each authorized still into a 2 to 15s walk-in talking clip from the written line. Use it for rental walk-in videos, listing walk-in talks, and property walk-in talking clips.
